### 📌 Pull Request Checklist

Thank you for contributing to **Awesome-Virtual-Cell-2026**! Please ensure your contribution complies with our curation principles:

- [ ] **Section Alignment**: The paper or benchmark is placed in the most logically appropriate section (1 through 6).
- [ ] **Formatting**: Follows the existing Markdown table format: `| Year | Paper | Venue / Type | Benchmark / Key Dataset | Code / Project | Core Contribution / Focus |`.
- [ ] **Links Verified**: Direct PDF/arXiv/bioRxiv URL and official repository links are active and working.
- [ ] **Benchmark Explicitly Specified**: The primary single-cell dataset or atlas benchmark used in the experiments is listed in the `Benchmark / Key Dataset` column.
- [ ] **No Commercial / Low-Quality Spam**: Only peer-reviewed or high-caliber preprint works with concrete methodologies.
